rows.label: Helios Blueprint
rows.note: the Deconstructor arrives with the built Helios

conditions: Helios Prime does not give this weapon; it comes with Deconstructor Prime, a separate Mastery item.
The Deconstructor has no blueprint of its own, so a sold copy means building another Helios.

groups.activity: build Helios, then level the Deconstructor

rows.label: free Companion Slot
rows.note: one for Helios, one for the Deconstructor

conditions: Equip the Deconstructor on Helios and level it to 30; Helios levels as its own Mastery item at the same time.

disclosures.title: leveling the weapon
disclosures.body: It is a projectile with travel time that misses moving or knocked-down targets, and it takes melee and thrown-melee mods but not heavy-attack, combo, finisher, block or set mods. It still gains affinity from your kills while equipped.
